quotations.old_english: Cometae synd gehátene ða steorran ðe fǽrlíce and ungewunelíce æteówiaþ
Ðære sǽ gemengednyssa and ðæra ýða swég ungewunelíce gyt ne ásprungon
quotations.english: it has not been unusual for them to occur already

source_text: un-gewunelíce; adv. Unusually, in an unwonted manner :-- Cometae synd gehátene ða steorran ðe fǽrlíce and ungewunelíce æteówiaþ, Lchdm. iii. 272, 4. Ðære sǽ gemengednyssa and ðæra ýða swég ungewunelíce gyt ne ásprungon (it has not been unusual for them to occur already), Homl. Th. i. 610, 12. [O. H. Ger. un-giwonalíhho insolite.]
